answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when independent audits confirm coordinated duplicate identities, with audits triggered by randomly sampled tasks and evidence shared across the network. A mirror account cannot earn trust merely by copying another’s history: it must risk its own capital and pass fresh checks. Spinning up a comet-like burst of aliases therefore multiplies the attacker’s locked funds and potential losses, while a walnut-sized budget can support only a few credible identities.
